name: Tomato
description: Anime streaming provider for Tomato. Requires a manual Bearer token from a logged-in Tomato account (login uses a captcha that cannot be automated).
author: Jhoorodr

fields.name: token
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.description: A valid Bearer token from a logged-in Tomato session. Login uses a captcha that can't be automated, so get this from the official app's network traffic or from the Aniyomi/Mihon Tomato extension's own 'Manual Token' field. See USAGE.md for step-by-step instructions.
